Package neqsim.process.engineering

Class NorsokOffshoreEngineeringBuilder

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.NorsokOffshoreEngineeringBuilder
public final class NorsokOffshoreEngineeringBuilder extends Object
Builds a deterministic Norwegian-offshore engineering proposal from a NeqSim process.

Rules identify functions and assessments normally required by the cited standards. They deliberately do not assign SIL, final trip limits, materials, or relief capacity. Those decisions require project-specific hazard analysis, design data, and accountable engineering approval.

    • fromProcessModel

      public static List<EngineeringProject> fromProcessModel(String name, ProcessModel processModel, boolean registerProposedInstruments)
      Builds one governed engineering project per area in a multi-area process model.

      DEXPI packages are area documents, so a ProcessModel is intentionally split into its constituent ProcessSystem objects. Shared inter-area streams remain present in each area's process topology and can be reconciled by their model tags in a document-management layer.

      Parameters:
      name - common engineering project name
      processModel - simulated multi-area model
      registerProposedInstruments - true to add generated instruments to areas without measurement devices
      Returns:
      engineering projects in process-model insertion order

    • registerProposedInstruments

      public NorsokOffshoreEngineeringBuilder registerProposedInstruments(boolean register)
      Controls whether proposed ISA-style measurement devices are added to the runnable process and consequently to the DEXPI P&ID. The generated alarm and trip thresholds remain proposals requiring review.
      Parameters:
      register - true to add generated devices
      Returns:
      this builder
